why: Camping at Hawthorne Hills is planned, not built (read 2026-11-17). Its park page (ozaukeecounty.gov/720/Hawthorne-Hills-Park) offers only trails, river/pond fishing and grills, and the Waubedonia page (/670) still calls Waubedonia 'the only Ozaukee County Park that offers camping'. The Hawthorne Hills Master Map 2026 is a DRAFT dated 3/19/2026, and its inset campground loop is keyed 'Future Tent Campsite' / 'Future RV Campsite'. Ozaukee Press of 2026-04-29 says the bathrooms are only at design stage (Kueny Architects contract, $43,166) and 'Plans call for installing 32 campsites, most of them suitable for recreational vehicles'. No opening date is published anywhere found, so the March 2026 fee-table rates ($22 basic / $30 water-electric) are set ahead of construction.
name: Hawthorne Hills County Park
flags: Re-check for 2027 or later: a 32-site county campground, mostly RV sites, is planned at 4880 County Hwy I, Saukville. It would be on the Ozaukee County Planyo booking calendar alongside Waubedonia (3490). Nothing in the DB within 2 km (nearest entry 3490 Waubedonia, roughly 7 km north); no 'Hawthorne Hills' entry.
The fee table names the campsites under HAWTHORNE HILLS COUNTY PARK: 'CAMPING - BASIC SITE $22.00', 'CAMPING - WATER/ELECTRIC $30.00' (Fees and Fines, March 2026, DocumentCenter/View/27264).
